zh: 一、服務像櫃檯，回答問題和允許辦事是不同層次
en: 1. A service is a reception desk: answering questions and allowing actions are separate

zh: 二、FTP 做什麼？先分開指令與資料
en: 2. What does FTP do? Separate commands from data first

zh: 三、FTP 能列舉哪些資訊？每個要求都有範圍
en: 3. What information can FTP enumerate? Each request has a scope

zh: 四、匿名登入代表使用共同身分，權限仍要另外確認
en: 4. Anonymous login uses a shared identity; permissions still need checking

zh: 五、讀一份 FTP 合成紀錄
六、FTP、FTPS、SFTP，名稱相近但不能混用
en: 6. FTP, FTPS, and SFTP have similar names but are not interchangeable

zh: 七、SMTP 是郵件收送櫃檯，先區分投遞與寄件提交
en: 7. SMTP is a mail delivery desk: distinguish transfer from submission

zh: 八、SMTP 回覆能透露功能，但帳號線索要審慎判讀
en: 8. SMTP replies disclose capabilities; interpret account clues carefully

zh: 九、讀一份 SMTP 合成紀錄：功能清單不是測試結果
en: 9. Read a synthetic SMTP record: advertised features are not test outcomes

zh: 十、防護與驗證：讓業務正常，讓多餘權限消失
en: 10. Protection and verification: preserve business use and remove excess permissions

zh: 十一、最後只做一個小確認
